integrity: The generator matrix is reproduced from the public CodeTables entry. The proof reduces generalized weights to coordinate-subset rank nullities, and the bundled exact verifier exhausts all \(2^{23}\) subsets. No probabilistic sampling or floating-point computation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is the complete generalized Hamming-weight hierarchy of the specific dual Wagner code equivalence class. It does not determine the full dimension-eight projective extremal tables. The consequence \(m_2^{(2)}(8,3)=23\) is treated as already covered by the known 24-point Sidon maximum and is not part of the originality claim. A residual literature risk remains because the Simonis journal full text was not openly accessible in the inspected sources, although its accessible abstract concerns uniqueness rather than higher weights.
title: Complete generalized Hamming-weight hierarchy of the dual Wagner code
